days.file: Duccio di Buoninsegna - The Raising of Lazarus - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Raising of Lazarus
days.alt: Mary kneels at Jesus’s feet among the mourners while Lazarus stands in his burial wrappings in the open tomb.
days.look: Look again at Mary at Jesus’s feet. What do you most want to tell Him about the one you love?
days.license: Duccio died c. 1318; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Palsied Man Let Down through the Roof (Le paralytique descendu du toit) - James Tissot - overall.jpg
days.title: The Palsied Man Let Down through the Roof
days.alt: A paralysed man on a mat is let down on ropes through an opening in the roof, as the crowd below reaches up to receive him.
days.look: Look again at the mat coming down on its ropes. Whom would you carry to Jesus today?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Andrea del Verocchio - Tobias and the Angel.jpg
days.title: Tobias and the Angel
days.alt: The archangel Raphael and young Tobias walk side by side, the angel’s hand holding Tobias’s.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s hand beside Tobias’s. Who has walked beside you through a hard time, even if you only see it now?
days.license: Workshop of Verrocchio (Verrocchio died 1488); faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Christ Healing the Leper, from The Story of Christ MET DP855485.jpg
days.title: Christ Healing the Leper
days.place: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
days.alt: A leper kneels before Christ, who reaches out to touch him.
days.look: Look again at the hand reaching toward the kneeling man. What would you ask of Him, plainly and without holding back?
days.license: Pencz died 1550; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Bernardo Strozzi - The Healing of Tobit - 1993.5 - Cleveland Museum of Art.jpg
days.title: The Healing of Tobit
days.alt: Raphael and Tobias gently tend the eyes of the blind Tobit, who sits between them.
days.look: Look again at the fingers near Tobit’s eyes. For whom do you want skilled, gentle hands today?
days.license: Strozzi died 1644; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary - Raphael.jpg
days.title: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary
days.alt: Simon of Cyrene strains to lift the heavy cross-beam while Christ has fallen to his knees beneath it.
days.look: Look again at Simon, behind Christ, taking hold of the cross. Whose burden could you help carry this week?
days.license: Raphael died 1520; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Christ Healing the Mother of Simon Peter’s Wife by John Bridges.jpg
days.title: Christ Healing the Mother of Simon Peter’s Wife
days.alt: Christ in a rose-colored robe takes the hand of Peter’s mother-in-law as she lies on a couch, while women and disciples gather round.
days.look: Look again at Christ’s hand taking hers. What would you put into those hands today?
days.license: Artist died 1854; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: The Supper at Emmaus MET DP120945.jpg
days.title: The Supper at Emmaus
days.place: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
days.alt: At a table, Christ in a red robe looks gently toward two disciples as he breaks bread.
days.look: Look again at Christ’s face as the two disciples begin to know Him. What broken thing in you do you want Him to see?
days.license: Velázquez died 1660; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt - The Archangel Leaving the Family of Tobias - WGA19106.jpg
days.title: The Archangel Raphael Leaving the Family of Tobias
days.alt: Raphael rises in a glow of light as Tobias’s family kneel below in wonder.
days.look: Look again at the family kneeling in the shadow. What are you most thankful for after these nine days?
days.license: Rembrandt died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
